data.name: The Hive Pandemic
data.detailed_description:
The Hive Pandemic

The year is 2054. The infection has spread. The Hive is calling. Will you fight, or will you be consumed?

The world has changed. Corporations don’t just rule industries—they rule entire cities, entire planets. X-Corp and Goliath Corp, two of the largest corporate empires in the solar system, were founded by rival siblings who inherited their father’s trillion-dollar empire. But money and power weren’t enough. Their war for dominance has shaped the modern world, pushing the limits of science, technology, and the very nature of life itself.

You are Sam, a cyborg bounty hunter, one of the many outcasts exiled after the Cybernetic Pandemic of 2044—a failed experiment where X-Corp attempted to create a Hive Mind that would link all cyborgs into a single, controllable network. Instead, it turned them into rampaging cybernetic zombies, nearly wiping out entire cities. Now, a new Hive threatens humanity, but this time, it’s not man-made.

It’s alien.

Your Mission:

Goliath Corp has hired you for a high-risk job: track down and capture Clark Andrews, a fugitive infected with an alien Hive Mind. The infection is spreading, and Clark may hold the key to understanding—or stopping—it. But bringing him in is only part of the job. Goliath doesn’t just want his body. They want his mind.

With your advanced cybernetics, you are one of the few capable of entering his infected consciousness, diving into the depths of an alien intelligence that warps reality itself. As you explore Clark’s fractured mind, you will uncover horrifying truths about the Hive, its origins, and its true purpose.

But not everything is as it seems. Goliath has other plans, and you may just be another pawn in a game played by those far more powerful. The infection is spreading. The Hive is growing. And in the end, the biggest question isn’t whether you can stop it—it’s whether you’ll survive long enough to try.

Gameplay Features:

*All features advertised are being developed and are subject to change but will be finalized and polished before release.

🎮 Third-Person Combat

  • Engage in intense third-person firefights as you battle Hive-infected enemies and corporate assassins.

    🎮 First-Person Combat

  • Experience mind-bending first-person sequences underwater and  as you dive into Clark’s infected brain and fight to reclaim his mind from the Hive.

🔄 Multiple Playable Characters & Perspectives

  • Play as Sam, the exiled cyborg bounty hunter caught between a war of corporations and an evolving alien intelligence.

  • Step into the shoes of Croc, a ruthless fighter forced into the chaos, battling corporate android forces.

  • Take control of MB (Mistake Bot), an AI-powered machine built by a rogue Goliath employee, now hunted by the very company that created it.

🧠 A Living, Evolving Infection

  • The Hive isn’t just a disease—it’s an intelligent force. It spreads, adapts, and learns from your actions.

  • Reality shifts as you explore mindscapes twisted by the Hive, filled with surreal horrors, cryptic visions, and enemies that defy logic.

🌍 Expansive Sci-Fi World & Corporate Dystopia

  • Explore Arionis, a Martian colony originally built by X-Corp but now controlled by Goliath, a world shaped by corporate greed and war.

  • Uncover the truth behind X-Corp, Goliath, and the Hive, navigating a world where billionaires don’t just own companies—they own cities, countries, and even people.

  • Encounter a diverse cast of allies and enemies, each with their own stake in the battle for survival.

data.short_description: The Hive is Calling. Do You Have the Will to Resist? The fight for survival begins on Mars, but the war will take you back to Earth—where the infection is already spreading. With every battle, every mind you enter, and every secret you uncover, the Hive grows stronger. Are you just the next host?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 or Newer
  • Processor: 4 hardware CPU threads - Intel® Core™ i5 750 or higher
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card must be 2 GB or more and should be a DirectX 11-compatible
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 42 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
